arguments.message:
Hi there,

If a bank transfer has cleared on your side but still appears as unpaid, our billing team needs a few details to locate and apply it:

1. The date the transfer was sent
2. The exact amount transferred
3. The reference or description used on the transfer

Please send these details to our support team (or reply here), and we’ll trace the payment against our incoming transfers and apply it to your account. Bank transfers can take longer to reconcile than card payments because they arrive through a separate banking channel and often require the reference you used to match them correctly.

Thanks for your patience – we’ll get this sorted as quickly as possible.
